runs.summary: Rerun with nothing changed, 2012 comes out as it did: Obama wins, 332–206. The closest state was Florida, which went to Obama by 0.9 points. Every one of my 100 reruns reproduces it exactly.
howIGotThis: The numbers: the 2010 and 2020 census counts interpolated to 2012 and certified returns; every draw reproduces 2012 exactly before the change.
How sure: I reran it 100 times with different population and parameter draws.

women.quote: I think the President's done right by the auto workers. That matters out here. But I know plenty of folks who'll vote the other way tomorrow.
